title: Turnaround Targets and Bench Queue Standing by Service Level, Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service
content:
# Bench Standing Order: Turnaround Targets and Queue Standing by Service Level

The central bench works every piece taken in under the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service to the turnaround its service level targets, and takes pieces in the order the service levels rank. The figures below are the level figures the bench runs to.

| Service level | Queue rank (1 is worked first) | Target turnaround, business days from authorisation to completion | Rush turnaround, business days, where expedited handling is bought | Same-day work while the customer waits | Weekend intake | Work carried out at the chain's own bench | Loaner piece offered while the work runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Bench Service | 5 | 14 | 5 | no | yes | yes | no |
| Priority Bench Service | 3 | 7 | 3 | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Master Jeweler Service | 4 | 10 | 4 | no | no | yes | yes |
| Heritage Restoration Service | 6 | 25 | 12 | no | no | yes | yes |
| Designer Authorized Repair Service | 2 | 30 | 15 | no | no | no, sent to a partner workshop | yes |
| Atelier White-Glove Service | 1 | 4 | 1 | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Queue standing

The rank is the level's place in the bench queue, and rank 1 is worked first. Atelier White-Glove Service pieces are therefore taken ahead of every other level, and Heritage Restoration Service pieces, at rank 6, behind every other level.

## Turnaround targets

The target turnaround is the number of business days the workshop targets between the customer's authorisation and the bench finishing the work at that level. The rush turnaround is the shorter number of business days the workshop targets when expedited handling has been bought on the order. Both are counted in business days, not calendar days.

## Same-day work, weekend intake, in-house work and loaner pieces

Work is carried out while the customer waits only at Priority Bench Service and Atelier White-Glove Service. Pieces are taken in at the weekend at Standard Bench Service, Priority Bench Service and Atelier White-Glove Service, and not at the other three levels. Every level's work is carried out at the chain's own bench except Designer Authorized Repair Service, whose work is sent to a partner workshop. A loaner piece is offered while the work runs at Master Jeweler Service, Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service, and not at Standard Bench Service or Priority Bench Service.

## Hypothetical reading of the table

A hypothetical Master Jeweler Service order authorised on a Monday is targeted for completion 10 business days later; had expedited handling been bought on it, the target would be 4 business days. A hypothetical Standard Bench Service piece and a hypothetical Priority Bench Service piece waiting at the bench together are taken in rank order, so the Priority Bench Service piece, at rank 3, is worked before the Standard Bench Service piece, at rank 5, whichever was taken in first.
